marker_reviews.reason: The exactly-once catalog edits redirect the reader and writer to the single operative source crosswalk. The catalog contract proves both signatures, member source columns, archived historical tables, explicit grants, private generic-decision policies, and deferred state/member invariants. Archived rows retain their original relation identities and cannot be written. Synthetic SQL contracts cover mapping/conflict/unmapped, one-to-many membership, approval API concurrency and role-denial parity.
